text: ISO 22734-1:2025 specifies safety requirements for hydrogen gas generation appliances or systems using electrochemical water electrolysis.
GB/T 29729-2022 氢系统安全的基本要求 is listed as current, published 2022-12-30 and effective 2023-04-01.

GB/T 45541-2025 is a current national standard for PEM electrolyzer performance testing and covers instruments, test conditions, operations, emergency measures, power, hydrogen output/purity, energy use, and pressure testing calculations.

GB/T 46104-2025 covers test plan, data acquisition plan, pre-test checks, instruments, measurement methods, steady/dynamic/start-stop tests, and report content including purpose, instruments/equipment, operator qualification, calculations, charts, and conclusion.
GB/T 27748.2-2022 is the current Chinese national standard for performance test methods of stationary fuel-cell power systems.
IEC 62282-2-100:2020 covers construction, normal/abnormal operation, and testing safety requirements for fuel-cell modules.
IEC 62282-3-100:2019 applies to stationary packaged fuel-cell power systems for indoor/outdoor commercial, industrial, and residential use in non-hazardous areas.
ISO/IEC 17025 addresses competence, impartiality, and consistent operation of testing and calibration laboratories.
ISO/IEC 42001 specifies requirements for establishing, implementing, maintaining, and continually improving an AI management system.
ISO/IEC 23894:2023 provides guidance for effective implementation and integration of AI risk management processes.
The user announcement names T02 as equipment test-data analysis and automatic reporting and says enterprises provide desensitized data, technical Q&A, and materials.
The official interpretation page describes GB/T 45541-2025 as covering basic checks, basic tests, performance tests, and test-report requirements, with a stated PEM electrolyzer scope.

The official national-standard project page lists test scope, conditions, preparation, data-acquisition plans, pre-test checks, instrument accuracy, electrical/output/environment measurements, cold/hot start, steady, dynamic, shutdown tests, and report fields including purpose, instruments, operator qualification, calculations, charts, and conclusion.
